mapper.sql: id, order_no, user_id, total_price, payment, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark, payment_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (order_no, user_id, total_price, payment, status, receiver_name, receiver_phone, receiver_address, remark) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalPrice}, #{payment}, #{status}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{receiverAddress}, #{remark})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM orders WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
